Default is None (no lag features).
    lag_transform:Optional[List[Any]]=None, # List of lag-transformation function objects applied to each series independently and stacked vertically (e.g. [expanding_mean(shift=1), rolling_quantile(window_size=7, quantile=0.5, shift=1)]). Default is None (no lag transforms).

    difference:Optional[Union[int, Dict[str, int]]]=None, # Order of ordinary differencing to apply to each series before modeling. Default is None (no differencing).
    seasonal_diff:Optional[Union[int, Dict[str, int]]]=None, # Seasonal period for seasonal differencing (e.g. 7 for weekly, 12 for monthly, 24 for hourly). Default is None (no seasonal differencing).

    # - 'ets': Holt-Winters Exponential Smoothing trend estimation and removal.

*Global Panel Machine Learning Forecaster.*

Provides a unified model-agnostic interface supporting all scikit-learn
regressors, LightGBM, XGBoost, and CatBoost for pooled multi-series
panel forecasting. Each series generates its own lag and lag-transform
features under a shared feature schema stacked vertically across series,
and produces multi-step recursive forecasts returned as a dictionary
keyed by series ID.
